MikroTik 2.5in SATA 64GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6

The MikroTik 2.5in SATA 64GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License (Pre-Install) Level 6 is a high-performance storage solution designed for MikroTik routers, offering superior reliability, speed, and flexibility. This 2.5-inch SATA solid-state drive provides a robust 64GB of storage capacity, ideal for handling the data needs of various network management applications. Engineered to work seamlessly with MikroTik's PC-based machines and other supported server systems, it delivers excellent performance for a wide range of networking tasks. Equipped with UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) Boot, this SSD ensures compatibility with modern hardware configurations, providing a faster and more secure boot process than traditional BIOS-based systems. It comes pre-installed with RouterOS v7.11, the latest version of MikroTik’s powerful operating system, which offers enhanced features and security for efficient network management. The system also supports OS version updates and downgrades, ensuring flexibility for future upgrades or adjustments based on your network requirements. With the included Level 6 RouterOS License, users gain access to advanced networking features such as VPN, firewall configurations, multiple routing protocols, and other powerful tools that are perfect for building and maintaining secure, high-performance networks. This license enables extensive control and customization of your network infrastructure, catering to both small and large-scale deployments. The MikroTik SSD is available in a range of capacities, from 16GB to 128GB, allowing users to select the optimal size based on their specific needs. Additionally, the product comes with comprehensive technical support and warranty, offering peace of mind for users. Whether for upgrading an existing system or deploying a new network, the MikroTik 2.5in SATA 64GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS License provides a reliable, future-proof solution for all your networking needs.

MikroTik 64GB SSD UEFI x86 RouterOS 64bit License Level 6 Features

  • 2.5in SATA Solid State Drive
  • UEFI Boot
  • Build with PC Mikrotik Machine
  • Supported Server Mikrotik Machine
  • Capacity Available: 16GB / 32GB /64GB/ 128GB
  • OS Version Update and Downgrade Support
  • OS Version v7.11 Pre-Install
  • Technical and Warranty Support
